# Native Workflow Projection Storage Cohort

Stacked on approved increment 1 `e00c7785e`, integration base `06018d2e1`.
This self-contained cohort consumes the existing #2151/#2542 approval; no
new PR, generic query authority, compatibility seam or independent framework.

## Owners And Complete Consumers

The original control-status and conflicting-construction roots retain their
names and every workload/assertion. Component verifiers now consume opaque
WorkflowPersistence and detached fixed storage facts from one native selected
fixture; SQLite cells are added beside the original PostgreSQL cells.
Canonical run materialization precedes selected activation. The original native
transaction probe requires exactly one successful construction write, no
workflow-mutation write and no outstanding transaction after each root.

The two physical reads belong to backend/pipelinepersistence, with private
runtimepersistence adapters opening the existing selected read snapshot.
storetest only returns detached DTOs. Control read: es.current_state, es.fields,
and COALESCE(fi.config.status, ''). Duplicate read: es.revision, the name-field
default, and es.fields. Both preserve the original run/instance join and ONLY
the original requested run/entity filter; no route, entity type, readiness,
status, source authority or eligibility restriction is added. Native bytes
remain bytes, and decoding and all equality/refusal assertions stay in the
original consumers. Wrong identity, cancellation, unavailable ownership and
read failure return zero evidence, not a partial DTO.

These are the complete consumers of each new fixed read. The handed-off
receiver-construction read at preserved integration `888cb4958` is not an
equivalent owner: it exposes flow_instances revision, not entity_state revision,
does not expose physical config status, and has additional instance/type
predicates. No duplicate of C/G's handed-off read ports or pending pipeline
handoff operation is introduced. The list/shadow and malformed-shape fixture
roots in the same source file remain separate forthcoming cohorts; the four
mutation-seed callers also remain explicit parent debt.
